subject: qplot returns error on my system

messages.author: 74379c8698dff4ab
messages.subject: qplot returns error on my system
parts:
I'm running version 2.8.1 of R on a FreeBSD i386 machine. Just got
started with Wickham's book ("ggplot2") but unable to plot even the
most basic stuff. For example,

> qplot(carat, price, data=diamonds)

returns the following message:


Error in .Primitive("[")(dots[[1L]][[1L]], dots[[2L]][[1L]]) :
invalid subscript type 'list'

Any insights and help is highly appreciated.

Premal P. Vora
